ambiguity: The source defines a single L. Existing ontology offers ruleLength and classificationSocietyRuleLength, but broad quantity/ownership declarations alone do not distinguish an L record from a society reference or establish whether they are aliases. Generic development annotations and a society-name string cannot establish independent provenance.

options.decision: Retain the two existing distinct properties as separate supplied data roles.

roles.ruleLength: Recorded L used by the design
roles.classificationSocietyRuleLength: Separately supplied society rule-length reference datum

options.reason: Smallest interpretation consistent with existing explicit ownership, quantity declarations and source wording; no schema or checker change required. Source/schema judgments remain reviewed interpretations.

options.decision: Treat both fields as aliases for a single datum.
options.consequence: Current two-field evaluation construction would not test independent source/reference consistency; requires a separately authorized representation/evaluation redesign. Do not infer owl:equivalentProperty.

options.decision: Require independent classification-society documents and explicit provenance before admitting any supplied reference value.
options.consequence: Current synthetic fixtures do not contain such evidence; TRF-035 would remain blocked under that stronger scope.
